description:
FOUND s495 (Fable, 2026-09-21) preparing the s492c merge (POSIX, flock, fork `$$`, Time::HiRes = platform-touching).  The STANDING RULE (USER 2026-09-06, DECIDED line "we are not writing software for our laptop"): a change that touches the PLATFORM ships only after the install matrix is green WITH it, PLUS A macOS LEG (GitHub `macos-latest`, Homebrew).  MEASURED: `.github/workflows/` holds ci.yml (ubuntu-latest), install-matrix.yml (four glibc images in containers on ubuntu-latest), container.yml -- NO workflow mentions macos.  The rule was written for the PCRE2 spike, which was then PARKED, so the leg was never built; every platform-touching merge since has shipped on the glibc matrix + the local `tools/t/install-container.t` only.
WHAT IT TAKES (design sketch, not measured): a job `runs-on: macos-latest`; `brew install sbcl` (check the version against the 2.5.2 floor) + `cpanm PPI Moo` on the system or Homebrew perl; then the SAME shared recipe the matrix runs (`tools/install-matrix/` fresh-machine install + verify), then a SMALL platform battery rather than the whole gate (runner minutes): the rows that touch syscalls -- flock, fork/wait/`$$`, backticks `$?`, stat/filetests, sockets, signals, File::Temp, POSIX constants (errno / signal / fcntl NUMBERS DIFFER on Darwin: any constant the runtime or a shim hard-codes from Linux headers is WRONG there -- that is the first thing the leg will find; s492c's POSIX shim is the prime suspect, ask for its constant source).  Triggers: workflow_dispatch + push to main on paths `cl/**`, `lib/POSIX*`, `tools/install-*` (+ a weekly cron like the matrix).  `gh` is unauthenticated on the dev box: results are read through the public API (`curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Percolisp/pcl/actions/runs?per_page=5`).
USER DECISION: adding a workflow spends the USER's GitHub runner minutes (free for a public repo, but it is the USER's account) and will very likely go RED on its first run for real reasons (Linux-valued constants, `sb-posix` differences, `/proc`-isms) -- a red badge until they are fixed, or `continue-on-error: true` while it is being brought up.  Until it exists, a platform-touching merge says in its DECIDED record: "glibc matrix green; macOS NOT TESTED (#2196)" -- never silence.

MEASURED s495: the Linux-valued constants are ALREADY ON MAIN, not new with s492c -- `lib/Fcntl.pm` (`use constant O_CREAT => 64`), `lib/Errno.pm` (`EAGAIN => 11`), and s492c`s `lib/POSIX.pm` follows that practice (`sub O_CREAT () { 64 }`, `sub EAGAIN () { 11 }`).  On Darwin O_CREAT is 0x200, EAGAIN 35, SIGUSR1 30.  THE FIX SHAPE TO DESIGN (the XS model, like the core: decided AT INSTALL): `tools/install-pcl` generates one constants file from the TARGET machine (the local perl`s Fcntl/Errno/POSIX, or sb-posix) and the three shims read it; a checkout generates it on first use into ~/.pcl-cache.  Not a blocker for s492c (same practice as main), but the merge record says macOS NOT TESTED.
subject: INFRA GAP (USER decision): the macOS CI leg the standing portability rule requires DOES NOT EXIST -- no workflow runs on macos-latest; platform-touching merges have shipped on the glibc matrix only; Linux-valued POSIX/errno/fcntl constants are the first thing such a leg will catch
